description: This PHP class 'TranslationCollection' encapsulates collections of translation data used for internationalization within the OrangeHRM system. It holds mappings between keys, source texts, and target translations, providing methods to retrieve these collections.

classes.name: TranslationCollection
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class that manages collections of translation mappings, including key-to-source-target, key-to-target, and source-to-target relationships.

methods.name: getKeyAndSourceTarget
methods.description: Returns the mapping of translation keys to source and target texts.

methods.name: getKeyAndTarget
methods.description: Returns the mapping of translation keys to target texts.

methods.name: getSourceAndTarget
methods.description: Returns the mapping of source texts to target texts.
